en.headline: ICAC charges eight over MOS Burger ‘ghost worker’ payroll fraud
en.dek: A former store manager, his wife and six alleged ghost employees face conspiracy-to-defraud charges involving about HK$680,000 in wages and MPF contributions.
body: The Independent Commission Against Corruption charged eight people on Tuesday over an alleged scheme in which a former MOS Burger store manager and others falsely claimed wages for non-existent staff.

The defendants are a 39-year-old former manager of the Tin Shui Wai branch, his 28-year-old wife, and six people aged 24 to 33 who were listed as full-time or part-time shop assistants. They face a total of seven counts of conspiracy to defraud. The case was mentioned at Tuen Mun Magistrates’ Courts and transferred to the District Court for plea on 8 September; all were granted bail.

Prosecutors allege that between October 2022 and June 2024 the group used unauthorised smart cards to clock attendance and submitted false records showing more than 1,500 days of work that never occurred, causing the company to pay about HK$680,000 in wages and roughly HK$60,000 in Mandatory Provident Fund contributions. About HK$400,000 of the money was later passed to the former manager and associates.

zh.headline: 廉署起訴摩斯漢堡前店長等8人涉「鬼工」騙薪68萬
zh.dek: 前店長、其妻及六名被指虛報出勤的店務員被控串謀詐騙，涉薪金及強積金合共約74萬元，案件轉介區院。
body: 廉政公署周二落案起訴八人，指一名摩斯漢堡前店長等人涉嫌以「鬼工」方式虛報出勤紀錄詐騙薪金。
被告包括39歲天水圍分店前店長、其28歲妻子，以及六名年齡介乎24至33歲、被登記為全職或兼職店務員的人士，合共被控七項串謀詐騙罪。案件於屯門裁判法院提訊後轉介區域法院，定於9月8日答辯，各人獲准保釋。
控方指2022年10月至2024年6月期間，集團使用未經授權智能卡在值勤系統拍卡，並提交虛假出勤報告，令六人看來工作逾1500天，導致公司支付約68萬元薪金及約6萬元強積金供款；其中約40萬元其後交予前店長及同黨。
